This Criminal Original Petition has been filed to quash the proceedings in Spl.SC.No.13 of 2018 on the file of the learned Principal Sessions Court, Salem,
thereby taken cognizance for the offences under Sections 354A, 354B, 376, 511, 294(b), 506(i) of IPC and Section 4 of Tamilnadu Woman Harassment Act, 2002 and Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s) and P.Nagaraj @ Nagarajan vs State Rep

By on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63015575/
1 3(2)(Va) of SC and ST(PoA), Act 1989 as against the petitioner.
2. The learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the petition.
An endorsement to that effect has also been made.
3. In view of the endorsement, this criminal original petition is dismissed as withdrawn.

However,
the petitioner is at liberty to raise all the grounds raised in this criminal original petition before the trial court including the ground related to community.

Considering the age of the petitioner, the personal appearance of the petitioner before the trial court is dispensed with and he shall be represented by a counsel after filing appropriate application.
However, the petitioner shall be present before the Court at the time of furnishing of copies, framing charges, questioning under Section 313 Cr.P.C. and at the time of passing judgment.
Further, the trial Court is directed to https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis complete the trial within a period of six months from the date of receipt of copy of this Order.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
